"Hard HAT and Work BOOTS"
Day: 22 Tuesday 10-22-24

Warm Up: Pack the work cooler. Fill the thermos! It's a work day.

1. a. BACK SQUAT 7 sets of 3 reps @ 70%
super set
b. DB Bulgarian Split Squats
7 sets of 3 reps
(Keep these light to med)
2 min rest between each super set

2. DEADlift 5 sets of 3 reps (70-75%)
90 sec rest between sets

super set all 3
3. a. DB RDL's 4 sets of 5 reps
b. DB Concentration Curls 4 sets of 10 reps each arm
c. DB Lateral Raises 4 sets of 20 reps
90 sec rest between each superset

Cardio
Suitcase/waiter's Carry
6 total sets of 30 yds
* 3 each way
90 sec rest between sets
* Just like we did on day 14.

Recovery
Pot Roast
*extra Meaty
30 min walk
Heavy Sleep

"Day 22: Hard Hat and Work Boots"
Warm up: Pack the work cooler. Fill the thermos! It's a work day.
1. a. Back Squat 7 sets of 3 reps @ 70%
super set b. Dumbbell Bulgarian Split Squats 7 sets of 3 reps
* Keep these light to med
rest 2:00 between each super set
2. Deadlift 5 sets of 3 reps @ 70-75%
rest 1:30
3. a. Dumbbell RDL's 4 sets of 5 reps
super set b. Dumbbell Concentration Curls 4 sets of 10 reps
* Each arm
super set c. Dumbbell Lateral Raises 4 sets of 20 reps
rest 1:30 between each super set
4. Suitcase/Waiter's Carry 6 sets
* 30 yds
* 3 each way
* Just like we did on day 14.
rest 1:30
Recovery: Pot Roast · Extra Meaty · 30 min walk · Heavy Sleep
